title: Closing and plans for a second session
summary: Rowe proposes a second session, McBee agrees, and the recording is paused.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Sounds wonderful. So we’ve been talking for over an hour. I wonder if we might do a revisit soon, because I’m surrounded by my notes here, which I hardly got to any of it, although I’ve so much enjoyed this conversation.
I’m just out of bed — I’m just beginning to wake up now.
Okay, well maybe on part two we’ll go at like 4 P.M. or something like that.
Yeah, I would like that. I find this very pleasant and there’s a lot more that I feel I might be able to verbally get out of myself.
Great. So I’m just going to pause our recording here, and we’ll make a date to meet again.
Okay. All right. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
